notes.title: Moar Cheeves Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
I just finished adding Moar Cheeves! There are now 32 additional achievements - one for Winning and one for earning Best Lap on each track! Plus two more tracking the completion of those. Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE: Saves and Settings
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
Got an update here with Save Files implemented. It's a pretty simple system, best I could do for now. When you start a game you set the Active Save File. That's it!

I also put a Clear Settings button on the Options Menu. So now, if you change things in the Configuration Launcher they will persist between plays. If you mess something up in the Launcher and you want to reset it, just click this button.
Thanks!
Vinny
